description_en: Deletes a policy-based route by calling the DeleteVpnPbrRouteEntry operation
description_zh: 调用DeleteVpnPbrRouteEntry接口删除策略路由
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-vpn-pbr-route-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1a3kqjiiq9legfx0000 --route-source 192.168.1.0/24 --route-dest 10.0.0.0/24 --next-hop vco-bp15oes1py4i66rmd0000 --weight 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVpnPbrRouteEntry

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPN gateway instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: VPN网关实例所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR block of the policy-based route
parameters.name: route_source

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the policy-based route
parameters.name: route_dest

parameters.help_en: The next hop of the policy-based route
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en:
The weight of the policy-based route.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2526959.html operation to query the weight of the policy-based route
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由的权重值。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2526959.html接口查询策略路由的权重值
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to Ipsec (IPsec tunneling protocol)
parameters.help_zh: 隧道协议。仅取值：Ipsec（IPsec隧道协议）
parameters.name: overlay_mode

parameters.help_en:
The policy priority of the policy-based route.

If no policy priority was previously configured for the policy-based route, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a policy priority was previously configured for the policy-based route, you can choose whether to specify this parameter.

    If you specify this parameter, enter the policy priority that was previously configured for the policy-based route. If you enter a different value, the operation fails
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由的策略优先级。

如果您的策略路由之前不存在策略优先级，本参数可不填。
如果您的策略路由之前存在策略优先级，本参数可填，也可不填。

    如果您填写了本参数，请填写策略路由之前已配置的策略优先级，如果您填写为其他值，则当前接口会调用失败
parameters.name: priority
